sentences.text: Ashish Mohapatra have been granted interim protection subject to certain conditions.
5. As stated in the said order, crux of the issue relates to an investment in the complainant's company M/s Oagri Farm Private Limited, ('Oagri') where the petitioner is also a Director.
Investment was made through a Share Purchase Agreement dated 10th January 2022.

Thereafter,
certain disputes arose between erstwhile promoters and investors in the company.
Arbitration has apparently been invoked by Oagri, proceedings in which, it is stated, that Sole Arbitrator has since been appointed.
6. APP for State submits that petitioner is a foreign national.
Counsel for the petitioner confirms this fact and states that petitioner is a British national.
However, his passport has expired in December 2024 and has been submitted for renewal.
Petitioner undertakes not to travel abroad without prior permission of the Court.

7. Accordingly, till the next day of hearing the petitioner shall not be arrested subject to the petitioner joining and fully cooperating in the investigation as and when summoned by the I.O and producing documents required from them for the investigation.

8. List on 19th September 2024, the date already fixed, in the connected matters.
9.
Order be
uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J JULY 15, 2024/sm
